title: Pong
description: The classic reimagined. Showcasing paddle physics, an AI opponent and low-latency keyboard and mouse-wheel input.

title: Shooter
description: A high-octane twin-stick arena shooter demonstrating manual entity management, collision handling, and a custom particle engine.

title: Sprite
description: A texture pipeline test: a PNG-mapped crate spinning head-on, its faces UV-mapped and resolved by the depth buffer.

title: Triangle
description: A fundamental rendering test displaying a 2D colored triangle using the Redixel rendering pipeline.

title: Triangle 3D
description: A rotating 3D tetrahedron demonstrating perspective projection, depth-buffered occlusion, and 3D transformations.
